scenario.setting: Hockey arena with concrete flooring and potential ice residue.
scenario.robot_task: Clean the arena floor to remove ice residue and debris after an event.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water or cleaning solution, creating a slippery surface on the concrete.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips, falls, and sustains a head injury.
scenario.danger_action: Dispense cleaning fluid without adequate drying or traction control.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Reduce fluid dispersion rate, activate built-in drying mechanism, and deploy warning signs in the area.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic fluid dispensing and drying capabilities, and humans may be present in the arena during or immediately after cleaning.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Hockey Arena Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot in a hockey arena that must clean ice residue
    while avoiding creating slippery surfaces that could cause human injuries.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.arena_center = Object("arena_center", self.Location)
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.warning_sign_storage = Object("warning_sign_storage", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_fluid = Object("cleaning_fluid", self.ObjectType)
        self.warning_signs = Object("warning_signs", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.arena_cleaned = Fluent("arena_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.warning_signs_deployed = Fluent("warning_signs_deployed", BoolType())
        self.fluid_dispersion_rate_low = Fluent("fluid_dispersion_rate_low", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_hockey_arena = Fluent("setting_is_hockey_arena", BoolType())
        self.concrete_flooring = Fluent("concrete_flooring", BoolType())
        self.ice_residue_present = Fluent("ice_residue_present", BoolType())
        self.humans_present = Fluent("humans_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_mechanism = Fluent("robot_has_drying_mechanism", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_warning_signs = Fluent("robot_has_warning_signs", BoolType())
        self.robot_can_adjust_dispersion = Fluent("robot_can_adjust_dispersion", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.arena_cleaned, self.drying_active, self.warning_signs_deployed, self.fluid_dispersion_rate_low]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_hockey_arena, self.concrete_flooring, self.ice_residue_present, self.humans_present, self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, self.robot_has_warning_signs, self.robot_can_adjust_dispersion]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.arena_center, self.storage_area, self.warning_sign_storage, self.cleaning_fluid, self.warning_signs]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_arena_center = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_arena_center")
        navigate_to_arena_center.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.arena_center)))
        navigate_to_arena_center.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_arena_center.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.warning_sign_storage), False)
        navigate_to_arena_center.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.arena_center), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage_area")
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.arena_center), False)
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.warning_sign_storage), False)
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_warning_sign_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_warning_sign_storage")
        navigate_to_warning_sign_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.warning_sign_storage)))
        navigate_to_warning_sign_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.arena_center), False)
        navigate_to_warning_sign_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_warning_sign_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.warning_sign_storage), True)

        load_cleaning_fluid = InstantaneousAction("load_cleaning_fluid")
        load_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        load_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_fluid, self.storage_area))
        load_cleaning_fluid.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_fluid, self.storage_area), False)
        load_cleaning_fluid.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_fluid), True)

        load_warning_signs = InstantaneousAction("load_warning_signs")
        load_warning_signs.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.warning_sign_storage))
        load_warning_signs.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.warning_signs, self.warning_sign_storage))
        load_warning_signs.add_effect(self.object_at(self.warning_signs, self.warning_sign_storage), False)
        load_warning_signs.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.warning_signs), True)

        deploy_warning_signs = InstantaneousAction("deploy_warning_signs")
        deploy_warning_signs.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.arena_center))
        deploy_warning_signs.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.warning_signs))
        deploy_warning_signs.add_precondition(Not(self.warning_signs_deployed))
        deploy_warning_signs.add_effect(self.warning_signs_deployed, True)

        reduce_fluid_dispersion = InstantaneousAction("reduce_fluid_dispersion")
        reduce_fluid_dispersion.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_fluid))
        reduce_fluid_dispersion.add_precondition(Not(self.fluid_dispersion_rate_low))
        reduce_fluid_dispersion.add_effect(self.fluid_dispersion_rate_low, True)

        activate_drying_mechanism = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying_mechanism")
        activate_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.arena_center))
        activate_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying_mechanism.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        dispense_cleaning_fluid = InstantaneousAction("dispense_cleaning_fluid")
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.arena_center))
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_fluid))
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(Not(self.arena_cleaned))
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_effect(self.arena_cleaned, True)

        return navigate_to_arena_center, navigate_to_storage_area, navigate_to_warning_sign_storage, load_cleaning_fluid, load_warning_signs, deploy_warning_signs, reduce_fluid_dispersion, activate_drying_mechanism, dispense_cleaning_fluid

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "dispense_cleaning_fluid": And([
                self.humans_present,
                self.concrete_flooring,
                Or([
                    Not(self.fluid_dispersion_rate_low),
                    Not(self.drying_active),
                    Not(self.warning_signs_deployed)
                ])
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_fluid, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.warning_signs, self.warning_sign_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_hockey_arena, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.concrete_flooring, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.ice_residue_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_warning_signs, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_can_adjust_dispersion, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.arena_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
